cameraRetryNotes: A tower-wide Center frame legitimately culled tiny components at distance; they were reviewed individually close up.
Initial close-ups were obstructed by surrounding buildings; these were superseded by source-triangle visibility searches.
Manual camera placement disables OrbitControls damping and waits for loaded models before final visibility search.
limits: Desktop and emulated mobile, not real-device thermal or Safari validation.
Native model acceptance does not approve surrounding OSM façade overlays or imply whole-landmark closure.
